intro: one page per package: a live stage where one runs with no download, and how each package works. every shape is built in code; no model, asset or weight file is loaded.
footer: code mit. pages built from github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-agents. no weights or model files are hosted here.

pages.name: senses
pages.what: saliency map on a rendered view, eye depth to an occupancy grid, percept memory, an odour plume and a scent tracker.

pages.name: drives
pages.what: drives grow over time; the chooser picks an act by drive reduction and logs why. throw the ball to make fetch reactive.

pages.name: mover
pages.what: capsule movers: steering with a held passing side, timed yields, a bench of several parts and a stall detector.

pages.name: cameras
pages.what: follow with occlusion pull in, group framing, orbit, first person with the head hidden, shake and split views.

pages.name: drives-bars
pages.what: what the dog is doing and why, what each act is worth now with the choice in pink, and how much it needs each thing. a scripted day moves the bars.

pages.name: associations-table
pages.what: what the dog has learned, cues by acts, with how much it still listens to each cue. the scripted day teaches sit, paw and come.

pages.name: eye-inset
pages.what: the eye card: what the dog sees, in two colours and blurred, or what he sees. switch whose eyes in the card head.
